description.value:
The iron packed by Yorinobu Arasaka during his troubled youth. As beautiful as it is deadly.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 14 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, TUp (Double Bounce) Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6). When making a Ricochet Attack with this weapon it can ricochet off up to two different surfaces in order to hit its target (e.g., bouncing around two corners, or bouncing off the ground to bound off a wall to hit someone across a room, etc). Doing so incurs a -4 penalty to the Attack Check, unless performing an Aimed Shot Ricochet, in which case the penalty is -10.

Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, TUp (Double Bounce) Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
